theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_perimeter_compactness
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)), (∀ i, MeasurableSet (F i)) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ φ : Euclid m → Euclid m, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball 0 R → (∀ v, ‖φ v‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ v in F i, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid m) (fderiv ℝ φ v).toLinearMap ≤ c) → ∃ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (F' : Set (Euclid m)), StrictMono σ ∧ MeasurableSet F' ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => volume (symmDiff (F (σ i)) F' ∩ ball 0 R)) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
